latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add burned-in subtitles to DaVinci Resolve videos via cloud AI.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV files up to 500MB for automatic subtitle generation.
- Fast cloud rendering: download captioned MP4 files in 30–60 seconds.
- No manual editing; just describe the subtitles you want and get video back.
- Simple token-based authentication with 100 free credits for 7 days.
- Supports direct editing and export workflows for video editors and YouTubers.
- In-app error handling and tips for best results.
